# Release build trigger: 0.7.0rc3

This commit deliberately triggers the publish workflow. It packages only the immutable, CI-verified source SHA `63c96b4ceda8f5f2c0b632f411bb17eeec581e13`, not the publisher branch itself. Output: public HA integration ZIP, SHA256SUMS, authenticated Actions artifact, GitHub prerelease (never latest). No production installation or actual invoice issuance.
